area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors
description: How a country's tax clearance is read from sale fields. The receipt prints as a tax document only once the sale is cleared. System Manager only.

fields.description: Who writes the result: an installed fiscal app (for example zatca_erpgulf), or Outside service via the API.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Each company needs a fiscal regime row with Clearance Required, or its receipts print with no tax receipt number.
fields.label: Companies

fields.description: The POS Invoice field holding the clearance status.
fields.label: Status field

fields.description: The POS Invoice field holding the tax receipt number the authority gave the sale.
fields.label: Tax receipt number field

fields.description: Optional. POS Invoice field with the authority's QR code. Printed as stored once cleared.
fields.label: QR field

fields.description: Optional. POS Invoice field with the authority's seal or signature. Printed as stored once cleared.
fields.label: Seal field

fields.description: The only role allowed to write the results: the outside service's own role. Nobody can type a cleared status.
fields.label: Writer role

fields.description: The service's integration users: the only users who may hold the writer role.
fields.label: Writer users

fields.description: What each value the source writes means for the receipt. Unlisted values change nothing.
fields.label: Status values

lede: Which sale fields hold a fiscal service's result, and what each status means. A manifest installs it.
name: Retail Fiscal Reader

fields.description: CLEARED or REPORTED: prints with the tax receipt number. PENDING: the receipt waits.
fields.label: Means
